title: Licence gates
text: A page with no licence recorded is refused by the gate. The gate is a rule, not a preference.

title: Address collisions
text: Two chunks can receive the same address. An ordinal breaks the tie so neither is lost.

title: Vector routing
text: The index routes a query to the nearest cells and rescores the candidates from the float32 blob.

title: Compaction
text: A summary that drops a decision produces confident wrong answers, so every summary carries its seq range.

title: Claims
text: A claim is one row per task with a lease, so a dead agent releases its work when the lease expires.
